rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); SkiaCanvas::draw_sdf_shape_with_shader now grows its draw rect by the declared reach exactly as draw_with_sksl already does, so a glow or outer feather paints past the shape rect where it was previously cut off, and it refuses (returns false, draws nothing) a glow or outer feather whose reach is under 3 sigma; Canvas::sdf_feather_min_reach() exposes that floor as a pure function. The refusal covers only the chart path: draw_with_sksl still accepts a short reach and draws the glow clipped at its padded rect. The knob's chart draw now carries the feather sigma, curve and mode declared with the shader's geometry, which it previously dropped, so a feathered knob chart changes pixels inside the knob as well as outside it. A knob chart whose reach is under 3 sigma is no longer drawn: the knob logs an error once and falls through to its draw_with_sksl body shader, as it does for any chart draw that fails, so a knob that used to paint its clipped chart now paints its body shader (or its default body when it has none). Unfeathered charts and feathers that stay inside the shape draw the same pixels as before. No design-import, Chromium, packaging or authority boundary moves; the Pulp canvas target has not adopted a Vellum package.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart glow paints past the shape rect out to its reach'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'WidgetBridge knob chart glow paints outside the widget rect'
